title: The Boom in AI Agents
summary: Liquidity, bitcoin, airlines and AI agents.
assessment: The bounded liquidity call was directionally useful but its smooth path failed in April. The yuan direction held through the cutoff, and the agent-security concern has independent support. Bitcoin and memory forecasts remain open. The most important weaknesses are vague horizons and causal leaps from persistent agent memory to RAM demand, and from gold trade to reported GDP.

claims.claim: Gold transfers distort headline growth signals.
claims.reason: The accounting distinction is correct: investment gold movements are not production. However BEA already removes them from national accounts. The particular January GDPNow revision requires archived model vintages; a raw trade swing cannot simply be called a distortion of published GDP.

evidence.title: Nonmonetary gold in national accounts
evidence.finding: BEA removes investment gold trade and substitutes domestic production less industrial use. Investment-gold transfers are not domestic production.

claims.next_check: Reconcile January GDPNow model updates with its then-current gold adjustment.
